this-that.title: sa a
this-that.bodyMarkdown:
Use **sa a** after a noun for “this” or “that.”

For example:

**machin sa a** — this car / that car

The demonstrative comes after the noun.

these-those.title: sa yo
these-those.bodyMarkdown:
Use **sa yo** after a noun for “these” or “those.”

For example:

**machin sa yo** — these cars / those cars

Homework examples also combine this pattern with ownership.

object-exchange.title: Jan and Mari sort their things
object-exchange.bodyMarkdown:
**Jan:** Mari, liv sa a se pou ou.

**Mari:** Mèsi, Jan. Kaye sa yo se pou ou.

**Jan:** Mèsi.

This combines demonstratives, possession, and familiar polite language without adding a new question pattern.
